import importlib.util, random, sys, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def classes(pp):
    d = {}
    for q, v in enumerate(pp):
        d.setdefault(v, []).append(q)
    return sorted(sorted(v) for v in d.values())

def moore_unbounded(n, trans, accept):
    part = accept[:]; blocks = 2
    if blocks == 1 or len(set(part)) == 1:
        part = [0]*n; blocks = 1
    while True:
        getter = part.__getitem__; marks = {}; newp = [0]*n; c = 0
        for q in range(n):
            sig = (part[q],) + tuple(map(getter, trans[q]))
            i = marks.get(sig)
            if i is None:
                i = c; c += 1; marks[sig] = i
            newp[q] = i
        if c == blocks or c == n:
            return newp, c
        part, blocks = newp, c

rnd = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3)
bad = 0
t0 = time.time()
for trial in range(3000):
    n = rnd.randint(1, 60)
    sigma = rnd.randint(1, 4)
    # random reachable total DFA
    trans = []
    for q in range(n):
        trans.append([rnd.randrange(n) for _ in range(sigma)])
    accept = [rnd.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]
    ref, rb = moore_unbounded(n, trans, accept)
    ones = sum(accept)
    part = accept[:] if 0 < ones < n else [0]*n
    blocks = 2 if 0 < ones < n else 1
    got, gb = m.hopcroft(n, sigma, trans, part, blocks)
    if classes(ref) != classes(got):
        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH', n, sigma, accept, trans)
        print(classes(ref)); print(classes(got))
        if bad > 3: break
    # also verify the built-in minimize() agrees (uses moore with cap 48)
    acc, nxt, dist = m.minimize(n, sigma, trans, accept)
    if len(acc) != rb:
        bad += 1
        print('MINIMIZE SIZE MISMATCH', len(acc), rb, n, sigma)
print('hopcroft randomized: %d trials, %d mismatches, %.1fs' % (3000, bad, time.time()-t0))

# targeted: force the hopcroft fallback inside minimize() by lowering the cap
old = m.MOORE_ROUNDS
m.MOORE_ROUNDS = 1
bad2 = 0
for trial in range(1500):
    n = rnd.randint(2, 80)
    sigma = rnd.randint(1, 4)
    trans = [[rnd.randrange(n) for _ in range(sigma)] for _ in range(n)]
    accept = [rnd.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]
    ref, rb = moore_unbounded(n, trans, accept)
    acc, nxt, dist = m.minimize(n, sigma, trans, accept)
    if len(acc) != rb:
        bad2 += 1
        print('fallback mismatch', len(acc), rb)
m.MOORE_ROUNDS = old
print('fallback path: %d mismatches' % bad2)
